title: Bimodal Symmetry Collapse under MSE Regression
trigger_condition: Obstacle centered on corridor centerline (Y_obs = 0.00m) with symmetric rangefinder returns
consequence: Policy outputs conditional mean vy = 0.00 m/s, flying straight into obstacle until halted by supervisor emergency brake (100% standoff)
proposed_remedy: Stateless Clearance Guidance layer injecting deterministic left tie-break or categorical intention head

title: Autoregressive Velocity-Copying Shortcut (r=0.9723)
trigger_condition: UAV at low speed or stationary near obstacle (e.g. after supervisor caution braking)
consequence: Policy copies measured body vy into action vy; cannot initiate lateral evasion from standstill or hover
proposed_remedy: Zero-out body velocity features during training or mask them during near-obstacle regimes; currently bypassed by guidance override

title: Zero Low-Speed Standoff Demonstrations (0 / 47,780 transitions)
trigger_condition: Forward speed throttled below 0.20 m/s within 0.50m of obstacle
consequence: Drone operates in complete out-of-distribution state where neural network has zero training coverage
proposed_remedy: Generate diverse low-speed standoff recovery demonstrations; standalone curriculum fine-tuning broke nominal flight (Phase 4K)

title: PPO Unilateral Mode Lock (Rigid Rightward Asymmetry)
trigger_condition: Right-shifted obstacles (Y_obs < 0.0m) creating constricted right-hand passage (<0.50m)
consequence: Policy commands vy = -0.23 m/s into wall bottleneck, causing 88% timeouts and 12% overall benchmark success
proposed_remedy: Bilateral symmetry loss or mirror data augmentation during PPO training; currently sidelined

title: RadioLink CrossFlight Hardware Driver is Staged Skeleton
trigger_condition: Attempting physical flight controller communication via RadioLinkCrossFlightAdapter
consequence: Class does not import pymavlink or initialize serial port; send_velocity_command raises PermissionError in read-only and returns False otherwise
proposed_remedy: Implement real PyMAVLink serial driver with telemetry parsing (#0, #30, #84) and bench-tested GUIDED mode velocity setpoints

title: Charging Station Docking Implementation is 100% Absent
evidence_file_line: Workspace search yields zero docking/charging modules
trigger_condition: Reaching terminal goal coordinate (X=9.5m, Y=0.0m, Z=1.0m)
consequence: Simulation terminates on spherical distance (d<=0.35m); no visual AprilTag detection, no vertical descent, no docking contact verification exists
proposed_remedy: Design and implement visual docking vision module, downward precision rangefinder, and terminal docking state machine

title: Supervisor Default Inconsistency Across Tooling
trigger_condition: Instantiating SafetySupervisor() without explicit config in CLI tools or Web GUI viewer
consequence: Silent fallback to class default obstacle_caution_dist_m = 0.80m, inducing the 1% time-budget starvation timeout bug in GUI/CLI runs
proposed_remedy: Update call sites to pass SafetySupervisorConfig(obstacle_caution_dist_m=0.50) explicitly

title: Sim-to-Real Aerodynamic Wall Effect (Bernoulli Suction)
trigger_condition: UAV operating within 0.20-0.25m of corridor side walls at cruising speeds
consequence: Rotor downwash creates low-pressure Bernoulli suction against wall; real airframe will be attracted into collision unlike PyBullet rigid-body physics
proposed_remedy: Perform tethered bench test in confined corridor; evaluate minimum safe physical wall clearance (>0.25m)

title: Multi-Zone ToF Sensor Specular Dropouts on Smooth Walls
trigger_condition: High-angle rangefinder beams (>60 deg) striking painted or glossy corridor walls
consequence: Specular reflection returns false maximum distance (4.0m), blinding the clearance guidance layer to wall proximity
proposed_remedy: Bench-test VL53L5CX / multi-zone ToF sensors against actual corridor surface materials

title: Missing Stochastic Exploration State (log_std) in PPO Checkpoints
trigger_condition: Attempting to resume stochastic PPO fine-tuning from saved checkpoints
consequence: Checkpoints contain actor and critic state dicts but omit log_std; cannot resume RL exploration without arbitrary noise re-initialization
proposed_remedy: Serialize complete optimizer and distribution state in future RL training harnesses
